# bst260project-template

Instructions and template for projects for 2026 HSPH BST260

Your project will be a working GitHub pages site that presents your
interpretation of features of public health datasets.

Please see
[instructions](https://vjcitn.github.io/bst260project-template/articles/instructions.html)
to set up the infrastructure for your project and to learn about
available datasets

Please see [project suggestion
text](https://vjcitn.github.io/bst260project-template/articles/stubs.html)
for some suggestions of how you might proceed with project work on
selected datasets. More content will be added to this page in the near
future.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cdcfiremort`](https://github.com/vjcitn/bst260project-template/reference/cdcfiremort.md)
  : data from CDC on rates of mortality by firearm by state by year
- [`cdcmurd`](https://github.com/vjcitn/bst260project-template/reference/cdcmurd.md)
  : data from CDC on homicide rates by state by year
- [`gunleg`](https://github.com/vjcitn/bst260project-template/reference/gunleg.md)
  : data from RAND corporation on historical record of state
  legislatures actions on firearms control
- [`waterborne`](https://github.com/vjcitn/bst260project-template/reference/waterborne.md)
  : data from CDC on waterborne and foodborne illness events
